items.exampleEn: I go swimming three times a week.
He is always late for class.
I read a book every night.
My sister visits us once a month.
items.exampleZh: 我姊姊每個月來看我們一次。

items.exampleEn: The baby is four months old.

items.sentenceEn: I never drink coffee at night.

items.audioEn: Amy works four days a week. She never works on Sunday.
items.audioZh: Amy 一週工作四天，她星期天從來不工作。

items.sentenceEn: Please call me at this number.
She always calls her mother at night.
items.sentenceZh: 她總是在晚上打電話給她媽媽。

items.stemEn: I ____ eat meat. I only eat vegetables.
items.stemZh: 我從來不吃肉，我只吃蔬菜。

items.stemEn: There are about four weeks in a ____.
items.stemZh: 一個月大約有四個星期。

items.passageEn: Leo works at a hospital. He works four nights a week, from Monday to Thursday. He always sleeps in the morning, and he never works on the weekend. Today is Friday, so he is free. He is going to see a movie with three friends.
items.passageZh: Leo 在醫院工作。他一週上四天夜班，從星期一到星期四。他總是早上睡覺，週末從來不上班。今天是星期五，所以他有空。他要和三個朋友去看電影。

rubricZh: always 常放在一般動詞前（例如 always study）
「在晚上」可用 at night、in the evening 等
「讀書」寫 study 或 read 都可以

items.instructionZh: 用 never 造一個句子，說說一件你從來不做的事。
referenceEn: I never drink coffee at night.
rubricZh: never 常放在一般動詞前、be 動詞後（例如 I never eat、I am never late）
never 本身就是否定，句子不再加 not
